questions.questionText:
Which of the following is irrational?
A) 0.25  B) √2  C) 3/4  D) 0.5

The value of log₁₀(1000) is:
A) 1  B) 2  C) 3  D) 10

The power set of {a,b} contains how many subsets?
A) 2  B) 3  C) 4  D) 5

A factor of x²−9 is:
A) x−9  B) x+9  C) x−3  D) x²+3

The common factor of 6x and 9x² is:
A) 3x  B) 6x²  C) 9x  D) 3x²

The solution of 2x+5=13 is:
A) 3  B) 4  C) 5  D) 9

sin 30° equals:

A) 3  B) −3  C) 5  D) −5

If the corresponding sides of two triangles are proportional and their corresponding angles are equal, the triangles are:
A) congruent only  B) similar  C) always right-angled  D) unequal

The graph of y=2x+1 is a:
A) circle  B) straight line  C) parabola  D) pair of parallel lines

The locus of points equidistant from the endpoints of a segment is its:
A) angle bisector  B) perpendicular bisector  C) median  D) altitude

The arithmetic mean of 2, 4 and 6 is:
A) 3  B) 4  C) 5  D) 6

The probability of getting a head when a fair coin is tossed is:
A) 0  B) 1/4  C) 1/2  D) 1

Write the equation of the horizontal line through (7,−9).
Two similar triangles have corresponding sides in ratio 2:3. Find the ratio of their areas.
questions.answerText: Area ratio is the square of side ratio: 2²:3²=4:9.

questions.questionText: If two corresponding angles of two triangles are equal, and their third angles are also equal, what can be concluded?
questions.answerText: The triangles are equiangular and therefore similar.

questions.questionText: The sides of two similar triangles are in ratio 3:5. If a side of the smaller is 9 cm, find the corresponding larger side.
Find y when x=3 in y=2x−1.
Give two points that lie on y=x+2.
Define the perpendicular bisector of a line segment.
questions.answerText: A line through the segment's midpoint and perpendicular to it.

questions.questionText: What is the locus of points at a fixed distance from a fixed point?
questions.answerText: A circle centred at the fixed point with the given radius.

questions.questionText: Find the arithmetic mean of 4, 6, 8 and 10.
Find the mode of 3, 5, 5, 6, 7, 5, 8.
questions.answerText: The mode is 5, as it occurs most often.

questions.questionText: Find the median of 2, 4, 7, 9, 12.
A fair die is rolled. Find the probability of getting an even number.
Define sample space for a single coin toss.
questions.answerText: S={H,T}, the set of all possible outcomes.

questions.questionText: Q5 — (a) Simplify √50+√8. (b) Solve log₁₀x=−2.
Q6 — (a) For A={1,2,3,4} and B={3,4,5}, find A∪B and A∩B. (b) Factorize x⁴−5x²+4.
Q7 — (a) Solve 2x−3≤7 and represent the solution interval. (b) Prove (tanθ+cotθ)²=sec²θ cosec²θ.
questions.answerText: (a) 2x≤10, x≤5; interval (−∞,5]. (b) tanθ+cotθ=(sin²θ+cos²θ)/(sinθcosθ)=1/(sinθcosθ); squaring gives sec²θ cosec²θ.

questions.questionText: Q8 — (a) Find the distance between A(0,2) and B(3,6), and state the slope of AB. (b) Two similar triangles have corresponding sides 6 cm and 9 cm. If the area of the smaller is 24 cm², find the area of the larger.
questions.answerText: (a) Distance=√[(3−0)²+(6−2)²]=5; slope=(6−2)/(3−0)=4/3. (b) Side ratio=2:3, area ratio=4:9; larger area=24×9/4=54 cm².

questions.topic: Chords and Arcs of a Circle
questions.questionText: A chord AB subtends 48° at a point C on the circumference. Find the angle subtended by the same chord at the centre and state the theorem.
questions.answerText: Angle at centre=2×48°=96°. The angle at the centre is twice the angle at the circumference standing on the same arc.

questions.topic: Tangent and Angles of a Circle
questions.questionText: From external point P, PA and PB are tangents. If OP=13 cm and radius OA=5 cm, find PA and PB.
questions.answerText: OA⊥PA. PA=√(13²−5²)=12 cm; tangents from P are equal, so PB=12 cm.

questions.questionText: Construct the circumcircle of a triangle with sides 5 cm, 6 cm and 7 cm. Describe the construction.
questions.answerText: Construct the 5-6-7 triangle using SSS. Draw perpendicular bisectors of two sides; their intersection O is the circumcentre. With centre O and radius to a vertex, draw the circumcircle.
